name: Whale Line — film format v1

gates.frame_jump: PASS — measured on screen, per story

deviations: The whale keeps its own colours (character continuity) rather than the story’s Wada combination
summary: A reusable film format: one line of thinking draws the sea; the little whale swims under it and hops onto each key word on the beat; the camera pulls back to show the whole line as the summary. A story is a small JSON file: title, 4–8 words with one-line glosses, a Wada combination, BPM.
changes: New format. The whale rig moved into the style kit (whale-rig.js), coloured only from tokens.
